$comment: Assets the workspace saves: links and notes. Every document must match this JSON Schema (draft 2020-12); backd adds id and _meta itself.

title.description: What the asset is called. Required.

kind.description: A URL worth keeping, or a written note.

tags.description: Free-form labels; where={"tags":"docs"} finds documents whose array contains the value.

published_at.description: null while a draft. Stored as a BSON date so filters, ranges and sorting compare instants.

file.description: Reserved for file management, a later tutorial chapter.
